caption:
Google's Project Suncatcher aims to test AI compute in space. 🚀 The initiative will launch a prototype satellite to evaluate the performance of Tensor Processing Units (TPUs) beyond Earth. With the potential for scalable machine learning infrastructure, the project could reshape tech development for various industries.

Should we be excited about AI in space? 

Sources: Google Blog, TechCrunch, Space.com
